[[File:Sebulba_racing.jpg|170px|thumb|Sebulba, champion of the Galactic Podracing Circuit.]]
The '''Galactic Podracing Circuit''' was a series of seven [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses across the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. They were often considered to be harder and comprising of a longer distance than the courses found in the [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]]. The circuit began on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]] and ended on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while also revisiting tracks at [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], [[Ord Ibanna]], and twice on [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] was the reigning champion of the Galactic Podracing Circuit, and even had his own course named after him.

An alternative format of the Galactic Podracing Circuit would be made up of two other subcircuits: the [[Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit|Outer Rim Regionals]] and the [[Professional Podracing Circuit]], each with three one-lap races. Both subcircuits featured a race on Tatooine, with the former also including [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] while the latter visited [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
Completing races in the Galactic Circuit in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' would unlock the playable characters [[Toy Dampner]], [[Mawhonic]], and Sebulba. Completing the last race of the circuit would play the game's credits, while finishing first in every race would unlock the third race in the [[Invitational Podracing Circuit]].
